name: E-commerce & Booking
headline: Websites that *sell or take bookings*.
promise: Online stores, product catalogues and appointment or table booking are custom projects. We agree the catalogue, payments, booking rules and schedule in writing, give you a fixed quote, and build only after you approve it.

included.title: Scope written first
included.text: Products, categories, delivery areas, booking slots, cancellations and refunds are agreed in writing before any build starts.

included.title: Payments you control
included.text: We connect a payment gateway account you open in your own name, such as Razorpay, and test it before launch. Gateway fees are paid to the provider.

included.title: Booking rules that hold
included.text: Time slots, capacity and confirmations set up to your rules, and tested so the same slot cannot be booked twice.

included.title: Catalogue built for phones
included.text: Product or service pages a customer can browse comfortably on a phone, with prices and options clear before checkout.

included.title: Order and booking alerts
included.text: New orders and bookings reach you by email or WhatsApp, as agreed in the quotation.

included.title: Basic technical SEO
included.text: Titles, descriptions and structured data for your products or services, and a Search Console submission. Google decides rankings.

process.text: Your products or services, how customers pay or book, and the rules you already follow at the counter.
Scope, milestones, payments and a schedule. You approve it or walk away.
Pages, checkout or booking, then real test orders and bookings on a staging site.
The site goes live, and you get the logins and a walkthrough of how to manage products or bookings.

faqs.q: Which payment gateway do I need?
faqs.a: For most Indian businesses a gateway such as Razorpay covers UPI, cards and net banking. You open the account in your own name; we connect and test it.

faqs.q: How long does an online store take?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of products, payment and delivery rules and integrations. Your quotation states the schedule once the scope is agreed.
Gateway fees, your domain renewal and hosting, and any paid plugins or services. Each is written in your quotation before you pay. Maintenance is optional and quoted separately.

faqs.q: Can I manage products and bookings myself?
faqs.a: Yes, as agreed in the scope. You get the logins and a walkthrough at handover.

faqs.q: Is e-commerce included in the ₹7,999 or ₹17,999 packages?
faqs.a: No. Those packages exclude online payments, e-commerce and advanced booking. They are custom work, priced by written quote.

cta: Tell us what you sell or what customers book, and we will reply with the questions that set the quote.
